focus: Streaming text response, queued browser TTS fallback, safer interruption UX, and call-style UI

gates.name: Evaluation Gate
requiredEvidence: 10 interruption attempts with at least 9 successes

knownGaps: Text replies now stream through /api/conversation/message/stream and the fallback TTS uses a sentence queue, but this is still browser TTS when Doubao realtime is unavailable.
Doubao binary protocol is implemented behind DOUBAO_REALTIME_FORWARD_BINARY_PROTOCOL, but live provider smoke is still required.
Browser MediaRecorder currently sends WebM/Opus chunks; official provider may require raw Opus or PCM AudioWorklet conversion.
Provider audio/text delta polling exists, but true end-to-end playback quality, caption timing, and latency are not yet manually verified.

Automatic barge-in is deliberately behind a visible experimental toggle because the local RMS VAD can still false-trigger in noise; production should use Silero/WebRTC VAD or LiveKit/Pipecat turn-taking.
Text model activation must be smoke tested before judging assistant quality.
Web search has framework shape but lacks production search provider evidence.
Sensitive memory confirmation needs stronger regression coverage.
nextActions: Run npm run test:voice:realtime after streaming UI and binary protocol integration.
Run npm run test:voice:secret to ensure provider credentials are not committed or returned.
Run browser manual acceptance for streaming subtitles, queued TTS, mic meter, and explicit interrupt button.
With user-approved env, run a live Doubao provider smoke using DOUBAO_REALTIME_FORWARD_BINARY_PROTOCOL=true.
If provider rejects WebM/Opus chunks, replace MediaRecorder upload with AudioWorklet PCM16 capture.
